problem:
The absolute difference between the outcomes of one roll of two fair tetrahedral dice follows the probability mass function $f(x)$ shown in the table below. What is the expected value of the absolute difference of the outcomes of one roll of the two dice?

| $f(x)$ | $\frac{1}{4}$ | $\frac{3}{8}$ | $\frac{1}{4}$ | $\frac{1}{8}$ |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| $x$ | $0$ | $1$ | $2$ | $3$ |
worked_solution:
The expected value of a discrete random variable $X$ with probability mass function $f(x)$ defined over a set $S$ is given by

$$
\text{E}[X]={\sum }_{x\in S}x\cdot f(x).
$$

Summing up the products of each value of $X$ and its associated probability, we get

$$
\begin{aligned}\text{E}[X] & =0\cdot f(0)+1\cdot f(1)+2\cdot f(2)+3\cdot f(3) \\  & =0(\frac{1}{4})+1(\frac{3}{8})+2(\frac{1}{4})+3(\frac{1}{8}) \\  & =0+\frac{3}{8}+\frac{2}{4}+\frac{3}{8} \\  & =0+\frac{3}{8}+\frac{4}{8}+\frac{3}{8} \\  & =\frac{0+3+4+3}{8} \\  & =\frac{10}{8} \\  & =\frac{5}{4}.\end{aligned}
$$
